summary_en: This study compares nivolumab or pembrolizumab given on a standard schedule with the same drugs given on a less frequent extended schedule, in people with locally advanced or metastatic cancer. The drugs are given by IV, nivolumab 240 mg every 2 weeks or 480 mg every 4 weeks (standard) versus 240 mg every 4 weeks or 480 mg every 8 weeks (extended), and pembrolizumab 200 mg every 3 weeks or 400 mg every 6 weeks (standard) versus 200 mg every 6 weeks (extended). The study measures drug levels in the blood (pharmacokinetics), and the registry lists the phase as Phase 1.
summary_es: Este estudio compara nivolumab o pembrolizumab administrados con un esquema estándar frente a los mismos medicamentos administrados con un esquema extendido, con menor frecuencia, en personas con cáncer localmente avanzado o metastásico. Los medicamentos se administran por vía intravenosa: nivolumab 240 mg cada 2 semanas o 480 mg cada 4 semanas (estándar) frente a 240 mg cada 4 semanas o 480 mg cada 8 semanas (extendido), y pembrolizumab 200 mg cada 3 semanas o 400 mg cada 6 semanas (estándar) frente a 200 mg cada 6 semanas (extendido). El estudio mide los niveles del medicamento en la sangre (farmacocinética), y el registro indica que la fase es la Fase 1.
who_for: A physician has determined the person is a candidate for nivolumab or pembrolizumab
not_for: Previously received an immune checkpoint inhibitor

Planned treatment with ipilimumab or another anti-CTLA4 antibody combined with nivolumab or pembrolizumab
